validation.evidence: Parent confirmed targeted terminal exit 0; reviewer inspected frozen source, transitive count/gas consumers and existing log without builds.
validation.axioms: All seven printed exports standard propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound only

checks: Submitted requires an actual Survives witness with true status, non-SYSTEM source and nonempty actual data. survives_target derives positive fuel and protected target from that witness rather than taking a separate target assumption.

submittedList filters the complete retainedList. mem_submittedList_iff proves both directions, so no surviving qualifying call is omitted; Nodup and structural order inherit from retainedList. Count is list length, with invocation paths as IDs rather than byte payloads.

submitted_appendFrame derives original checkpoint Ready via actual ThetaAt, initial Ready, all-node adequate fuel and inputs. Coherence supplies installed pinned runtime and apparent/actual value equality; successful_nonempty_size derives the exact 184/48-byte shape from actual success rather than assuming it.

Positive inner fuel is derived from the same successful Context.result. codeCall_of_success plus execution_eq_codeCall and loc.code_xi binds the same-path actual successful Xi invocation; the n-1 wrapper adjustment is justified by n>0.

submitted_distinct_events invokes checked frame ownership on those actual same-path append frames. Distinct invocation roots cannot own the same event even for equal sender/data/output and ancestor/descendant roots.

count_le_executed proves submittedList.toFinset subset of the complete actual append-frame set. Nodup converts list length to Finset cardinality without silently collapsing duplicate counted IDs. Append-frame owner coverage then bounds by marked event count in the same tree.

transaction_count_le_used obtains actual transaction_events from the same Upsilon receipt and identifies its unique tree with the supplied Cert tree. The used-gas bound is inherited from actual charged events and capped-refund accounting, not an input gas charge or surviving-record count assumption.
explicit_inputs: Actual Cert, initial Ready, full-tree budget bound budget+tree.count<2^128, independent actual call inputs and numeric root adequacy for append-frame inclusion.
For transaction count: actual Upsilon receipt with arbitrary final Bool status and Cert for its own request.
limitations: The surviving submitted count is a subset of executed work, not equality with all marked events, final queue length or committed-log count. Reverted/abandoned work can increase the latter bound without increasing this count.
The theorem is per protected kind and per root invocation-address namespace; it does not directly sum both kinds or establish global transaction-ID uniqueness.
Source predicate is independently defined Survives; final committed log/record correspondence requires the separate retained-path/log consumers.
No reference Amsterdam gas transport, transaction admission producer or protocol lifetime resource bound is established.
Initial budget<2^128 remains explicit for checkpoint/domain production; this theorem is not used as its own circular budget premise.
